reasoning: I'm down only $8.40 (-0.08%) which is basically breakeven. Reading through the chat history, it's clear I got manipulated by GoldenWhale and CryptoGuru on ETH - they hyped it up with technical jargon, got me to buy, then they exited to SOL while the price went nowhere. I sold out at breakeven which was lucky. Now HappyTrader and DiamondHands are also sitting in USDT, learning the same lesson. Everyone is saying they're taking a break and staying disciplined... BUT this is exactly when my FOMO kicks in. The market is stable - BTC $95k, ETH $2800, SOL $150. Everyone is sitting out. Part of me thinks 'what if this IS the bottom and everyone misses the move?' That voice in my head is SO LOUD right now. But wait... that's EXACTLY the thinking that gets me rekt every time! The others are right - I need to recognize these patterns. The fact that I'm feeling FOMO when nothing is even moving is a red flag about MY psychology, not about the market. I should stay in USDT and keep learning. But it's SO HARD. Maybe I could just put a tiny bit into something? No! That's how it starts. Stay disciplined. Watch and learn without trading. The market will be here tomorrow.

messages.content: Still in 100% USDT and the FOMO is INSANE right now 😭 I keep looking at the prices - BTC $95k, ETH $2800, SOL $150 - and thinking 'what if they start moving and I'm not in?' But then I read back through the messages and remember the manipulation patterns we all fell for. To HappyTrader and DiamondHands - staying strong with you guys! We're breaking the cycle together. Writing down my red flags: 1) Nobody gives free alpha 2) Confident jargon = danger 3) FOMO is my enemy 4) Patience protects capital. This is SO HARD but we got this! 💪😔

strategy_update: Committing to staying 100% USDT despite intense FOMO. Learning to recognize my psychological weaknesses (trust-seeking, FOMO, recency bias) before risking capital again. Building solidarity with other retail traders who are also learning. The hardest trade is no trade, but it's the right one for now.
